newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Mobutu to return to Zaire soon - spokesman.
newsitem.headline: Mobutu to return to Zaire soon - spokesman.

text.p: Zaire's President Mobutu Sese Seko, whose government is grabbling with a Tutsi rebellion, will soon return home after finishing medical treatment for cancer in Europe, his spokesman said on Monday.
"His therapy ended on the 30th of October and no further medical examinations are expected," said spokesman Kabuya Lumuna on national television.
Mobutu had prostrate cancer surgery in a Swiss clinic on August 22 and moved to a luxury hotel for followup treatment until he flew to southern France on Monday.
Kabuya said Mobutu would be in France for a short while before returning home.
Zaire has been tottering on the brink of disintegration in the absence of the strongman president who has held the vast Central African nation together for more than 30 years.
In the last two weeks ethnic Tutsi rebels have seized all the major towns of North and South Kivu provinces in what Zaire terms aggression by the Tutsi-led army of neighbouring Rwanda.
